purpose: Install-independent tools and redacted historical evidence, not a new device measurement or a remote publication receipt.
trace_protection: The bounded decoder modifies only eight observed metadata ID slots in a new copy; original trace and AUX payloads remain unchanged. Unknown layouts and existing output directories are refused.
historical_target_address_validation: All 610502 occurrences / 19918 unique ranges were checked against capture-time maps, one executable PT_LOAD, independent coordinate formulas, ELF hash and whole-range bytes.
target_identity: Module names in the aggregate evidence are anonymous labels, not reusable module names or addresses.
limits: 小过滤样本仍只有 NO_SYNC，具体原因未闭合；成功样本也存在 reset/overflow 缺口。因此当前验证的是真实指令区间，不是无缺口完整执行路径或业务语义。
